profile.summary: Grouptrail is a software company that makes configurable platforms for education and workforce organizations. Its tools help schools, colleges and community partners manage programs such as career pathways, and track data, communications and outcomes.

review.notes: Grouptrail (FMYI, Inc.) is Portland, OR-based program-management software for education and workforce programs, and its homepage lists Oakland Unified School District as a client, which fits the Linked Learning services agreements. Summary, contact, headquarters and legal name are all shown on the cited About and home pages; only business contacts are used.
